title: Health hub: 24/7 MCP endpoint for Grok Bot (step 1 ring hub, step 2 iOS push)

nodes.detail: The one JSON both clients render: nights, sleep_debt, illness, cardio, activity, activity_daily, vitals, device, generated_at, digest. Unchanged in this effort; the hub stores it as-is.

nodes.label: hub store (SQLite snapshots)
nodes.evidence: cargo test -p oura-hub store: 2 passed (put/dedup/latest, prune)
nodes.detail: rusqlite table snapshots(received_at, generated_at, digest, body). Keeps latest + history so freshness is honest. Idempotent on digest.

nodes.label: agent status doc (oura-summary::agent)
nodes.evidence: cargo test -p oura-summary agent: 6 passed (open_health/crates/oura-summary/src/agent.rs)
nodes.detail: Pure fn status_from_summary(&Value, now) -> Value: last night, sleep debt, HRV/RHR vs baseline, illness state, today activity, latest HR, plus freshness (generated_at, age_min). Also sleep_nights(days), trends(metric, days). Lives in oura-summary so iOS can reuse it in step 2. Unit tests on a fixture summary.

nodes.label: MCP JSON-RPC (stateless)
nodes.evidence: cargo test -p oura-hub mcp: 4 passed (initialize, notifications, tools/list+call, error codes)
nodes.detail: Hand-rolled Streamable HTTP MCP, protocol 2025-06-18: initialize, notifications/initialized, ping, tools/list, tools/call. Generic over a tool table; returns application/json (no SSE). No sessions. Errors as JSON-RPC errors. Unit tests with fixed requests.

nodes.label: oura-hub server (axum)
nodes.evidence: tests/http.rs 4 passed; release binary smoke: /health, /ingest/summary, /mcp/<token> initialize + get_status_now via curl OK
nodes.detail: Binary oura-hub. Env OURA_HUB_TOKEN, OURA_HUB_BIND (0.0.0.0:8787), OURA_HUB_DB. Routes: GET /health, POST /ingest/summary (Bearer), POST /mcp and /mcp/<token>. Registers tools get_status_now, get_sleep, get_trends, get_activity over the latest snapshot. Token in path because Grok Bot config has url only. TLS is the reverse proxy's job.

nodes.detail: oura push --to URL --token T (or $OURA_HUB_TOKEN) --tz-offset H: build_summary with PythonRunner, POST via ureq, prints the hub reply. Committed in 4046286. Not yet run against a real oura.db + hub.

nodes.label: iOS HubPayload (overlay models on FFI JSON)
nodes.evidence: HubPushTests 7 passed (overlay, debt window rule, pass-through, rejects, endpoints, request, batch head)
nodes.detail: Pure: take the raw summaryJson string from oura-core and fold the on-device model results in (night stages by start_ds, sleep_debt only when its valid_days covers at least as much, cardio, illness, workouts). The Swift Summary struct drops fields the agent doc needs (generated_at, tz, metrics), so the raw JSON is the base, never the re-encoded struct. Unit-tested.

nodes.label: iOS HubPusher (URLSession, Keychain token)
nodes.evidence: Simulator E2E: Send Now pushed summary + 12580 rows to a local hub; /health max_event_id 12580; status line updated; full XCTest suite 28 passed
nodes.detail: HubSettings: url + enabled in UserDefaults, token in Keychain (AfterFirstUnlock), replication cursor ids + last summary SHA in UserDefaults. HubPusher.pushAll: summary first (skip unchanged SHA), then pages of raw rows to POST /ingest/events until the deadline (8 s on bgRefresh, 40 s otherwise, 60 s foreground, 120 s manual). Never sends the bundled seed DB.

nodes.label: AppHooks + RootView wiring
nodes.evidence: xcodebuild build OK; foreground push wired in RootView.load; afterSync wiring compiled (background path not exercised: no ring in the simulator)
nodes.detail: afterSync: push the base summary with the previous full summary's models overlaid; after bgProcessing models, push the full one. RootView.load: push after the foreground model run. Core.baseWithJson keeps the raw JSON so the summary is built once.

nodes.label: oura-store::replication (export/import rows)
nodes.evidence: open_oura 0b09689: cargo test -p oura-store 11 passed (paging, idempotent import, bad hex, JSON round trip)
nodes.detail: ExportBatch {devices, events(body_hex), readings, next ids, more}. export_after(after_event_id, after_reading_id, limit) pages in id order; import_batch is idempotent on the natural keys and recomputes decoded_json + name. The sync cursor is not copied. Lives in open_oura (feat/event-export); open_health uses it through the local [patch].

nodes.evidence: tests/http.rs ring_rows_round_trip_through_the_replica passed (auth, import, dedup, /health ids, paged export, schema-too-new 422)
nodes.detail: Second SQLite file OURA_HUB_RING_DB (default oura.db next to hub.db) with the oura-store schema: a full replica. oura dashboard --db runs on it. The iOS pusher and oura push talk to it over HTTPS (peers, no build dependency).

nodes.label: hub health_samples table + watch summary
nodes.evidence: cargo test -p oura-hub: health 4 + store health_upsert_query_and_delete passed
nodes.detail: hub.db table health_samples(uuid PK, kind, start/end unix, value, unit, category, source_bundle, source_name, device, metadata JSON). put_health upserts by uuid and applies deletions; queries by kind/window. watch.rs: pure summary over rows (per-source max for steps/energy to avoid iPhone+Watch double counts, latest HR/RHR/HRV/VO2max, last sleep by best source, workouts, freshness).

nodes.detail: Bearer. Body {tz_offset_s, samples[], deleted[]}. get_status_now gains a watch block. get_health_samples(kind, days, limit) returns raw rows.

nodes.label: iOS HealthReader (anchored queries, encoder)
nodes.evidence: HealthReaderTests 5 passed (encoder, paging + own-source exclusion + anchors, send failure keeps anchor, deadline/read errors, state round trip)
nodes.detail: HKAnchoredObjectQuery per type with persisted anchors (health-read-state.json next to the DB), pages of 2000, own-source samples excluded (no loop with the exporter). Encoder maps HKQuantitySample / HKCategorySample / HKWorkout to the hub row. Fake client in tests.

nodes.label: HubPusher.pushHealth + Settings toggle
nodes.evidence: Simulator E2E: toggle → HealthKit authorization sheet → Send Now; a 77 bpm sample entered in the Health app reached the hub, the app's own 5406 exported samples were excluded; XCTest 33 passed
nodes.detail: After the ring rows, send HealthKit pages until the deadline; anchors advance per accepted page. Settings: 'Include Apple Health data' toggle requests read authorization; status line shows last run and counts.

nodes.label: HealthKit background delivery (observer + wake)
nodes.evidence: HealthBackgroundTests 4 passed; simulator: Health-app sample reached the hub via the observer (hk-wake task logged) without Send Now; XCTest 37 passed
nodes.detail: HKObserverQuery per type, registered at launch in AppDelegate before launch ends; enableBackgroundDelivery on the toggle (hourly for the step/energy/time kinds HealthKit limits, immediate for the rest); disableAll on switch-off. HealthWake actor coalesces the burst of per-type callbacks into one pushHealth under a KeepAlive assertion, calls every completion handler afterwards, and reruns once for wakes that arrived mid-push. Unit-tested with a fake client and a fake push.

nodes.label: hub web routes + /api (rust-embed)

nodes.detail: src/web.rs: GET / and /{*path} serve web/dist embedded with rust-embed (SPA fallback, 'not built' page when dist is empty; build.rs creates the folder). GET /api/session, GET /api/summary (latest snapshot), POST /api/tool/{name} (the MCP handler), all Bearer.

Sidebar + 12-column grid, big numbers, explanatory copy. Pages: Summary, Sleep, Trends, Data. Token kept in localStorage; auto-refresh on visibility and every 10 min.

nodes.label: hub agent runner (claude/codex/cursor subprocess, SSE)
nodes.evidence: cargo test: agent parsers + fake-CLI stream + route tests passed (24 total); browser E2E with a fake claude script streamed a tool chip and the answer
nodes.detail: src/agent.rs: AgentConfig detects the CLIs, writes MCP configs (loopback hub URL with token, 0600), builds each CLI's command (Claude: -p stream-json + --mcp-config + allowed mcp tools + --append-system-prompt RULES; Codex: exec --json -c mcp_servers.health.url; Cursor: -p stream-json --approve-mcps with .cursor/mcp.json), maps JSON lines to Event, streams over mpsc. POST /api/agent/ask = SSE; GET /api/agent/providers. Same bearer auth as the web API.
